plan.objective: Stabilize at 6 life against Kellan and Sanctuary while converting landfall into a future lethal threat.
plan.guidance: Current turn 13, draw step: no immediate winning attack; no creatures currently controlled and opponent is at 18. Kellan and animated Sanctuary are tapped, but opponent untaps next turn and burn remains a clock. Play the Forest from hand. Cast Explorer for {2}{G}{G} first using four untapped Forests; two of six untapped Forests remain, alongside two already tapped. Then play Forest, triggering Explorer and both Ascensions. They can put counters and trample on a creature, but none is in play now. Explorer mills one card; reassess actual graveyard without assuming a useful land. No Veil in hand, so no protection reserve is available. Do not cast Hydra without productive landfall; absent an actual post-mill useful line, pass.

steps.label: Cast Icetill Explorer
steps.purpose: Establish Explorer before playing the drawn Forest.

procedure.basis: You may play an additional land on each of your turns.

steps.label: Play Forest from hand
steps.purpose: Trigger Explorer and both Ascensions; resolve triggers and mill, then reassess actual graveyard.

steps.label: Pass attackers
steps.purpose: Explorer is summoning sick; no justified attack.

phases.goal: Cast Explorer, play Forest, and reassess actual mill.
phases.guidance: Use four Forests for Explorer, then play the Forest in hand. Each Ascension triggers at four or more counters; choose no impossible creature target if none exists. Explorer mills one. Only use an actual land in graveyard if available permissions allow a productive play; no land is presumed. No Veil is in hand.

phases.goal: Pass unless actual mill results create a useful available action.
phases.guidance: Do not cast Hydra or Harmonizer absent a productive landfall sequence.

phases.goal: Rebuild while accounting for red's untapped resources.
phases.guidance: No usable protection in hand. Opponent's tapped sources untap normally; if a spell targets Explorer, no Veil response is available.
Explorer can block ground attackers but cannot block flying. Kellan has double strike; at 6 life count attacks and burn, and block only if it materially prevents lethal or preserves a critical line.
Recount life, board, hand, graveyard and Explorer permissions; assume no future draw or mill result.

may.purpose: Develop only after pricing the landfall sequence and retaining useful interaction mana.
